messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Keme Group is part of Leni Works. That is the reverse of 'Leni Works is part of Keme Group'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Keme Group is part of Leni Works. This makes Leni Works the wider body into which Keme Group fits.
